verdicts.title: Hamiltonian mechanics and Lie algebroid connections
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We develop a new, coordinate-free formulation of Hamiltonian mechanics on the dual of a Lie algebroid. Our approach uses a connection, rather than coordinates in a local trivialization, to obtain global expressions for the horizontal and vertical dynamics.
